_notes: Per-heritage-railway narrative content, keyed by the same heritage_slug that operators.pmtiles carries per segment and that data/heritage-railways.json uses. GENERATED by scripts/build-heritage-content.mjs from HERITAGE_META (curated) plus scripts/output/heritage-wikidata-report.json (resolved by scripts/fetch-heritage-wikidata.mjs). `intro` is assembled from curated type/length plus a location phrase taken from the matched Wikidata description — it never asserts termini or ownership, and hard-codes no count of railways or companies; see the generator header for why each of those is omitted. An entry whose _wikidata.suppressed is set was checked and its match REJECTED as the wrong entity — it has no website/Wikipedia link on purpose. _review lists per-entry match caveats (geo-unconfirmed / no-center / geo-only-title-differs) that a human should sweep.
